deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED: release/2026-03-20 - helm value parity check failed for key `meshProxy.sidecar.override`. Promotion blocked until review.

alice: :eyes: what exactly is different between staging and prod? any secrets involved?

deploybot: Found in staging values: `meshProxy.sidecar.override: true`. Absent in prod. Also: `meshProxy.image` staging -> `redwood/mesh-proxy:2026-03-18-hotfix`, prod -> `redwood/mesh-proxy:latest`.

ben: yep, staging team enabled a forced sidecar override to validate a custom proxy for canaries. Prod does not have that override or the pinned image. Could affect routing and healthchecks.

carla: so do we revert staging or pause the prod promote? we're in the 14:00 change window.

dinesh: hold the promotion. If we push prod without parity the proxy init path may differ and we risk 502s in front of multiple services. Options: (A) revert staging change, or (B) apply same override + pin image to prod and run a tiny canary.

alice: how invasive is (B)? can we patch prod values quickly?

ben: patch is small. Example prod values patch: 
```
meshProxy:
  sidecar:
    override: true
  image: redwood/mesh-proxy:2026-03-18-hotfix
```
But note: prod's TLS KMS alias is `proxy/tls/prod` while staging used `proxy/tls/stage-v2`. If we enable sidecar in prod we must ensure prod has the correct alias/cert; otherwise sidecar fails on boot.

carla: that secret mismatch is annoying. Can we map stage cert -> prod alias quickly without a long ops window?

dinesh: two short paths: create an alias `proxy/tls/prod-v2` that points to the same cert (needs audit + brief compliance note), or revert staging override which is safest and fastest. Revert requires a small staging hotfix and re-run of smoke tests.

alice: which has lower blast radius—revert staging or add alias + pin prod?

ben: revert staging is fastest and lowest risk. But it delays validating the proxy change. Adding prod alias + pin keeps canary fidelity but is operationally heavier and needs audit. Also pinned image has a slightly different default `connection_timeout_ms` setting that could change latency profiles.

carla: any DB or state migration tied to the proxy image change?

ben: no DB migrations. It's config/routing defaults only. Still want to treat it as a separate controlled rollout.

dinesh: proposal: pause the promotion now. Revert the meshProxy override in staging so non-proxy changes can go to prod this window. Create a follow-up to reintroduce mesh-proxy behind a feature flag during the next scheduled window with SRE oncall.

alice: +1. Carla, can you open the revert PR and run staging smoke? tag me when CI is green.

carla: opening PR to revert staging helm override now. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/infra-helm/compare/PR-482-revert-mesh-override

deploybot: Release promotion remains BLOCKED by rule: meshProxy.sidecar.override parity mismatch. Waiting for manual unblock.

ben: I'll prepare a values patch and a runbook for the prod alias path in case we need to pivot. Prefer revert for speed.

carla: PR created and CI triggered.

carla: CI smoke run: running smoke tests...
carla: CI smoke ✅. smoke logs: `service-mesh health: ok`, `ingress 200s: clean`, `sidecar init: skipped` (expected).

alice: @deploybot please re-run preflight check.

deploybot: Re-checking release/2026-03-20...

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT OK: meshProxy parity issue resolved (staging no longer has `meshProxy.sidecar.override`). Promotion allowed within change window.

alice: promoting now. Adding release notes entry to mention deferred mesh-proxy change and follow-up ticket.

ben: created follow-up ticket RN-1287 to schedule mesh-proxy reintroduction behind flag with SRE test matrix.

carla: thanks all, moving release forward. :rocket:

dinesh: action items captured:
- carla: revert helm override in staging + attach smoke logs
- ben: prepare prod values patch & alias runbook (backup plan)
- alice: coordinate with release manager to unblock once CI green
- dinesh: prepare audit entry template for possible alias creation

carla: final: release promoted. will follow up on RN-1287 in next planner.
